common.tagline: Uniting affected parents, exposing the system, demanding justice.

home.headline: You Are Not Alone
home.subheadline: Many parents face the same figures, the same patterns — each alone, behind closed doors. The platform exposes the patterns — without violating any publication ban — and connects those affected.
home.step1Body: Describe what happened — parental alienation, nzakut orders, false complaints, one-sided welfare reports.
home.step2Body: The system checks whether the patterns in your case — sustained parental alienation, a nzakut order without an evidentiary hearing, a custody change following a false complaint — appear in other cases involving the same figures.
home.step3Body: When enough cases register the same figure and pattern combination, the count speaks: an anonymous tally of patterns — factual evidence that cannot be denied.
home.privacyBody: Cryptographic commitments are timestamped on-chain before you are ever connected to anyone. The timestamp proves independence.
home.legalBody: 24 independent cases, each documented before any connection between cases was made — proving a system. The accumulated evidence serves litigation, regulatory complaints, and media.
home.patternsSubtitle: Each count is the number of cases that registered the same pattern independently.

CRIMINAL_EXONERATION_IGNORED.label: Criminal case closure disregarded
CRIMINAL_EXONERATION_IGNORED.desc: The court made custody decisions without considering the closure of the criminal case in the parent's favour.

EMERGENCY_ORDER_NO_HEARING_30_DAYS.label: Emergency nzakut order — no hearing within 30 days
EMERGENCY_ORDER_NO_HEARING_30_DAYS.desc: An emergency order was issued without scheduling an evidentiary hearing within the 30-day statutory limit (Youth Law section 4).

NZAKUT_NO_EVIDENTIARY_HEARING.label: Nzakut order without evidentiary hearing
NZAKUT_NO_EVIDENTIARY_HEARING.desc: The order was issued or extended without a full evidentiary hearing as required by Youth Law section 7.

CHILD_REMOVED_OVER_YEAR_NO_HEARING.label: Child removed for over a year without merits hearing
CHILD_REMOVED_OVER_YEAR_NO_HEARING.desc: The child was separated from a parent for more than one year without a substantive hearing on the merits.

WELFARE_REFERRAL_AT_FIRST_HEARING.label: Welfare referral at first hearing
WELFARE_REFERRAL_AT_FIRST_HEARING.desc: Welfare services were referred to the case at the opening hearing, before any evidence was examined.

WELFARE_REPORT_ONE_SIDED_INTERVIEW.label: Welfare report based on one-sided interview
WELFARE_REPORT_ONE_SIDED_INTERVIEW.desc: The welfare report was written based on interviews with only one side.

WELFARE_REPORT_NO_HOME_VISIT.label: Welfare report without home visit
WELFARE_REPORT_NO_HOME_VISIT.desc: The welfare worker did not visit the requesting parent's home before writing the report.

WELFARE_REPORT_CITES_DROPPED_ALLEGATIONS.label: Welfare report cites dropped allegations
WELFARE_REPORT_CITES_DROPPED_ALLEGATIONS.desc: The welfare report relies on allegations that were closed or unproven.

WELFARE_RECOMMENDATION_CHANGED_UNEXPLAIN.label: Unexplained change in welfare recommendation
WELFARE_RECOMMENDATION_CHANGED_UNEXPLAIN.desc: The welfare position reversed between reports without a substantiated reason.

EVALUATOR_SINGLE_SESSION_UNDER_90_MIN.label: Evaluation in a single session under 90 minutes
EVALUATOR_SINGLE_SESSION_UNDER_90_MIN.desc: The evaluator conducted only one session, shorter than required for a proper evaluation.

EVALUATOR_SINGLE_PARENT_ONLY.label: Evaluation of one parent only
EVALUATOR_SINGLE_PARENT_ONLY.desc: The evaluator interviewed only the parent who appointed them, without examining both parents.

EVALUATOR_NO_FEEDBACK_SESSION.label: No feedback session after evaluation
EVALUATOR_NO_FEEDBACK_SESSION.desc: The evaluator did not hold a feedback session as required before submitting the opinion to the court.

JUDGE_RUBBER_STAMPS_EVALUATOR.label: Judge adopted evaluator's recommendation without scrutiny
JUDGE_RUBBER_STAMPS_EVALUATOR.desc: The court adopted the evaluator's opinion in full without independent critical review.

GUARDIAN_MINIMAL_CHILD_CONTACT.label: Guardian ad litem — minimal contact with child
GUARDIAN_MINIMAL_CHILD_CONTACT.desc: The guardian ad litem met the child only once or not at all.

GUARDIAN_REPEATEDLY_BY_SAME_JUDGE.label: Guardian ad litem — repeatedly appointed by same judge
GUARDIAN_REPEATEDLY_BY_SAME_JUDGE.desc: The same guardian ad litem was repeatedly appointed by the same judge across multiple cases.

GUARDIAN_CONTRADICTS_CHILD_WISHES.label: Guardian ad litem — position contradicts child's wishes
GUARDIAN_CONTRADICTS_CHILD_WISHES.desc: The guardian ad litem advocated a position contrary to the child's expressed wishes.

patterns.title: Registered Procedural Patterns
patterns.subtitle: Each count is the number of independent cases that registered the same pattern against the same figure — each before any connection between cases was established.
patterns.privacyNote: No case content or identifiers are shown. Only pattern counts and figure roles.
patterns.legalNote: Each allegation was cryptographically timestamped on the blockchain before any inter-case connection was made. The timestamp proves independence — not coordination.
patterns.empty: No patterns have been publicly registered yet.
